methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: the present work aims to shed light on the contribution of ISO 14001:2015 and EMAS III to energy management

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Paper analyses the contribution of environmental-management standards (ISO 14001:2015 and EMAS III) to energy management through qualitative content analysis and an exploratory hotel case study. EnPIs and sectoral energy-efficiency indicators are discussed and catalogued from the standards' reference documents, but no EnPI/EnB measurement model is presented, proposed, evaluated, or characterised (no model variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach identifiable).

paper_type.evidence_quote: eight case studies focused on the Hospitality sector were analyzed

stage1.notes: Hybrid design: qualitative content analysis of ISO 14001:2015 and EMAS III standards plus exploratory study of eight Spanish hotels (Hospitality sector). Discusses EnPIs and catalogues EMAS SRD energy-efficiency indicators but characterises no EnPI/EnB measurement model; borderline eligibility judged false. Hotels are not a continuous-process industry, so level_3b is false.
